title.fil: Ligtas na pagtugon sa karahasan — bahagi 1

purpose.fil: Makinig sa ligtas at pribadong lugar, sundin ang lokal na protection pathway, at itala lamang ang awtorisadong detalye.
purpose.en: Given a disclosure or observation, respond privately and connect to the locally verified protection/health pathway.

group_size.fil: Tatluhan: BHW, residente at tagamasid; magpalit ng papel.
group_size.en: Triads: BHW, resident and observer; rotate roles.

materials.fil: Observer sheet at kasalukuyang lokal na gabay
materials.en: Observer sheet and current local guide

steps.fil: Basahin ang kaso: May residenteng nagbahagi ng concern tungkol sa kaligtasan sa bahay at ayaw marinig ng iba.
steps.en: Read the case: A resident shares a concern about safety at home and does not want others to hear.

steps.fil: Ipagawa ang unang desisyon bago ipakita ang paliwanag.
steps.en: Ask for the first decision before showing the explanation.

steps.fil: Ipakita o sabihin ang gawain: Makinig sa ligtas at pribadong lugar, sundin ang lokal na protection pathway, at itala lamang ang awtorisadong detalye.
steps.en: Demonstrate or explain the task: Respond privately and connect to the locally verified protection/health pathway.

steps.fil: Gamitin ang observer sheet, magbigay ng isang tiyak na pagwawasto at ulitin ang kritikal na hakbang.
steps.en: Use the observer sheet, give one specific correction and repeat the critical step.

debrief.fil: Aling bahagi ang nakumpirma sa lokal na gabay, at ano ang kailangang i-refer?
debrief.en: Which part was confirmed in the local guide, and what needs referral?

observe.fil: Ginamit ang kasalukuyang lokal na gabay at naipakita ang mahalagang hakbang: Makinig sa ligtas at pribadong lugar, sundin ang lokal na protection pathway, at itala lamang ang awtorisadong detalye.
observe.en: Avoids blaming or unsafe disclosure; records only authorized facts and escalates per protocol.

observe.fil: Ipahayag ang kuwento sa barangay meeting nang walang pahintulot o safety plan.
observe.en: Tell the story at a barangay meeting without consent or a safety plan.

output.fil: Isang nakumpletong observer sheet bawat kalahok.
output.en: One completed observer sheet per learner.

alternative.fil: Kung walang tatluhan, ipagawa nang paisa-isa sa facilitator at itala ang parehong indicator.
alternative.en: If triads are unavailable, observe each learner individually against the same indicator.

worksheet.fil: Isulat ang ginawa, feedback ng observer at hakbang na uulitin.
worksheet.en: Write the action taken, observer feedback and step to retry.
